name: Ostanni rozmovy: Kafe na krayu svitu.
original_name: Останні розмови: Кафе на краю світу.
source:
What will the end of life look like?

Most philosophers of the world are thinking about this question.

But no one knows what the moment will look like when your soul and you yourself will begin to dissolve in something majestic.

And what will your life look like from the outside, in your opinion.

Today you will find yourself in a place called: Cafe at the End of the World.

You are only a temporary guest like most here.

You will have the opportunity to listen to the stories of our last three guests.

Therefore, do not drag out the limited time for you and others.

Come in, sit down and enjoy the echoes of their past lives.

[Translated from [url=https://aniduo.itch.io/caffee-new]itch.io[/url]]
